dialogs.speaker: narrator
dialogs.text: Harie — a water village on the shores of Lake Biwa.

dialogs.speaker: narrator
dialogs.text: The spring water stays cold year-round. The same in summer as in winter.

dialogs.speaker: narrator
dialogs.text: This water has sustained the people's way of life.

dialogs.speaker: narrator
dialogs.text: Today, a traveler comes to visit this village.

dialogs.speaker: machi
dialogs.text: Is this Harie in Shiga Prefecture?

dialogs.speaker: machi
dialogs.text:
Why is it so quiet, even at the bus stop...
The sound of water is the only thing that seems so loud.

dialogs.speaker: machi
dialogs.text: Is that person over there in charge of this inn? Let me go introduce myself first.
